acceptance: `evolve lessons backfill` on a fixture corpus prints the pattern counts and writes nothing (red: unknown subcommand "backfill")
--write produces a ledger that `lessons recurrence` renders with the same counts
fix: Add `evolve lessons backfill [--write]`. It runs BackfillFromLessons over the lesson corpus and prints per-pattern counts and the skipped files. --write replaces the ledger atomically with the result. Exit 0; exit 2 when the lessons directory is unreadable. Document it in runtime-reference.md's operator commands.
source: console, 2026-09-30, core-function CLI inventory (operator request: a CLI request for each core function)
summary: `evolve lessons recurrence` renders .evolve/recurrence-ledger.json (cmd_lessons.go:29-40). recurrence.BackfillFromLessons seeds a ledger from .evolve/instincts/lessons/*.yaml and tolerates both lesson shapes (internal/recurrence/backfill.go:41), but only tests call it. A missing, reset or damaged ledger undercounts every historical pattern, and no command rebuilds it.
title: The recurrence ledger cannot be rebuilt from the lesson corpus, and BackfillFromLessons exists with no caller; add `evolve lessons backfill`
